decisions.reason: Adding Contact Source grouping, stage breakdowns, and contact-to-lead conversion to the report does not change how MeetAlfred replies update HubSpot Lead Status.
The report specification uses HubSpot but does not change the requirement to use or set up HubSpot as the CRM platform.
The requested funnel dimensions do not change the visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
The report specification does not change the behavior that maps accepted LinkedIn connections to a HubSpot status.
Using Contact Source to group a funnel is distinct from maintaining campaign lead lists and moving silent leads between lists.
The funnel-reporting change does not alter silent-lead selection, follow-up list creation, MeetAlfred transfer, or cleanup behavior.
Contact Source reporting and conversion metrics do not change the required synchronization of HubSpot lead lists to MeetAlfred.
The report consumes HubSpot contact data but does not change Apollo-to-HubSpot synchronization behavior or latency.
The client's note that Contact Source names campaigns is descriptive context for report grouping and does not alter the MeetAlfred campaign creation workflow.
The requested HubSpot report does not modify the campaign email account's HubSpot connection.
Grouping contacts by Contact Source does not change which LinkedIn profile URL type must be stored in the CRM.
The funnel-reporting specification does not change Apollo email enrichment or automatic synchronization of enriched emails to HubSpot.
